description: Search OneFindMe's buying guides and how-to articles (about 1,200 pages in 21 languages: wigs and hair, shoe and clothing sizes, customs and import tax by country, home problems, gadgets, gifts, sales events, AliExpress shopping tips). Returns matching guides with title, URL, language, summary and section headings. Use get_guide to read one.

language.description: Prefer guides in this language (ISO 639-1, e.g. en, fr, he, ar). Default: detected from the query script, else any.

max_results.description: How many guides to return (1-10). Default 5.

query.description: Topic in any language, e.g. "13x6 vs 13x4 lace wig", "מכס על חבילה מחו"ל", "taille chaussure chinoise".

name: search_guides
title: Search OneFindMe buying guides
